name: MoMoTrack
shortDescription: Open-source oracle that attests Mobile Money payments on Safrochain — verifiable receipts without screenshots.
description:
MoMoTrack Oracle brings Mobile Money (MoMo) transaction verification on-chain for Africa. It is a verification and provenance layer on top of licensed aggregators (PowerPay, Cotanipay, and others) — not a financial intermediary.

Developers integrate the MoMoTrack SDK client-side; successful payments are attested with privacy-preserving proofs, validated by the oracle, and recorded immutably on Safrochain. P2P apps, remittance platforms, tontines, and DeFi protocols get cryptographic payment proof instead of manual reconciliation or screenshot disputes.
statusNote: Oracle and SDK in development — follow the repo for release announcements.
